setup.zh: 风暴散了。洞庭湖上出了太阳，打鱼的船一只一只划出来。君山的竹子被雨洗过，每一根都有斑点，像泪痕。
setup.en: The storm breaks. The sun comes out over Dongting, and the fishing boats row out one by one. On Junshan the rain-washed bamboos are all spotted, as if with tears.

recap.zh: 洞庭的风暴散了，渔船出湖。第七鼎的气息在西边，峡的那一头。
recap.en: The storm over Dongting broke and the boats rowed out. The seventh cauldron's breath lay west, beyond the gorges.

text.zh: 第七鼎的气息在西边——溯江过峡，是梁州。禹生在那里。
text.en: The seventh cauldron's breath lies west — up the Jiang through the gorges, in Liang. Yu was born there.

exits.means: rests, ends the chapter, asks what comes next

text.zh: 今日到此为止。梁州的路，开的时候我会告诉你。
text.en: That is all for today. When the road to Liang opens, I will tell you.
